name: 興趣與休閒
summary: 週末做什麼：露營、騎車、收集東西、參加活動。

sentences.en: My hobby is painting animals and flowers.
sentences.zh: 我的興趣是畫動物和花。

sentences.en: I play the guitar every weekend with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我每個週末和朋友一起彈吉他。

sentences.en: We are going camping at the campsite in July.
sentences.zh: 我們七月要去露營地露營。

sentences.en: She takes photos of her cat every day.
sentences.zh: 她每天都替她的貓拍照。

sentences.en: They go shopping together on Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 他們星期六早上一起去購物。

sentences.en: The club has a quiz about music and films.
sentences.zh: 這個社團有一場音樂與電影的問答競賽。

sentences.en: We had a lovely picnic in the park last Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我們上星期日在公園野餐。

sentences.en: My brother plays music in the school club.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥在學校社團裡演奏音樂。

sentences.en: I like collecting old cameras and small books.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡收集舊相機和小書。

sentences.en: We are going to a music festival this summer.
sentences.zh: 我們今年夏天要去音樂節。

sentences.en: He rides his bike to the park every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天騎腳踏車去公園。

sentences.en: My sister dances well and plays the guitar too.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐跳舞也很好，也會彈吉他。

sentences.en: We put our tent near the beach and the sea.
sentences.zh: 我們把帳篷搭在海邊。

sentences.en: On holidays I read magazines and draw pictures.
sentences.zh: 假期裡我看雜誌，也畫圖。

tips: 拍照可以說 take photos 或 take a photo；take a photo with a camera 也完全正確，兩種說法都能用。
「去購物」「去露營」用 go 加上 V-ing：go shopping、go camping。
拍照用 take photos，相機是 camera，不要說成 take a picture with a camera。

name: 房屋與居家
summary: 家裡的房間、家具和日常在做的事。

phrases.en: put the keys on the shelf
phrases.ipa: ˌpʊt ðə kiːz ɒn ðə ʃelf

sentences.en: My house has a small living room and a kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我家有個小客廳和廚房。

sentences.en: We keep the cups in the cupboard above the cooker.
sentences.zh: 我們把杯子放在爐子上方的碗櫃裡。

sentences.en: Please take the rubbish out to the bin now.
sentences.zh: 請現在把垃圾拿到外面的垃圾桶。

sentences.en: I sit on the sofa and watch TV every evening.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚上坐在沙發上看電視。

sentences.en: The kitchen is next to the dining room upstairs.
sentences.zh: 廚房在樓上餐廳的旁邊。

sentences.en: She is tidying her bedroom and making the bed.
sentences.zh: 她正在整理臥室並整理床鋪。

sentences.en: We have a small garden behind the house.
sentences.zh: 我們家在房子後面有一個小花園。

sentences.en: The bathroom is next to my bedroom on this floor.
sentences.zh: 浴室在這層樓我臥室的旁邊。

sentences.en: Put your keys on the table near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 把你的鑰匙放在入口旁的桌上。

sentences.en: My father washes the car in the garage.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸在車庫洗車。

sentences.en: There is a computer on my desk in my room.
sentences.zh: 我的房間書桌上有一台電腦。

sentences.en: The curtains are green and the carpet is blue.
sentences.zh: 窗簾是綠色的，地毯是藍色的。

sentences.en: Close the door and turn off the light downstairs.
sentences.zh: 關上門，並關掉樓下的燈。

sentences.en: We live in a small flat near the park.
sentences.zh: 我們住在公園附近的一間小公寓。

tips: 房間名稱前面要加定冠詞 the：in the kitchen、in the bathroom、in the living room。
room 是房間，house 是房子；a two-bedroom flat 就是兩房的公寓。
樓上用 upstairs，樓下用 downstairs，兩者都當副詞用，不加 the。
